quotes: Focus drifts, intent remains. Choose the intent.
Think like a battery: when you are low, do not run everything at once.
Close one window, finish one task.
A calm desktop makes a calm mind.
Starting now beats being perfect later.
Everything running in the background eats your foreground focus.
Close a file today, open a project tomorrow.
Slow systems come from rushed decisions.
Finishing is as much a decision as starting.
Mute the noise. Keep the signal.
A plan is choosing where your energy goes.
